GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (21 Oct 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 170)
21 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Communication Control.
1. Air investigation aids of the quadrant and flight channel indicating type are required by the Allied Occupation Forces. Japanese facilities of this type are available at strategic points.
2. It is directed that the quadrant and flight channel indicator facilities at Sapporo, Kagoshima, Tokyo and Osaka be placed in operation immediately in the order listed.
3. Orientation for the flight channels and quadrants will be furnished the Board of Communications by the Chief Civil Communications Section of this headquarters as soon as determinations have been completed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
